verdict.rationale: SumUp provides an official JavaScript SDK (@sumup/sdk) with TypeScript declarations and code examples, plus an Agent Toolkit for LangChain, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, and MCP, and a managed MCP server, directly supporting AI-native SDK-based development. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond first-party docs, and confirmation of SDKs in other languages beyond JavaScript.
